simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁחַד (H7809) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: שָׁחַד (shâchad) means to donate , i.e. bribe First listed occurrence: Ezek 16 33.

definitions.full: H7809. shachad [ שָׁחַד ] verb give a present, bribe (Ecclus 35:14; Aramaic שְׁחַד , bribe ; perhaps also Assyrian šidê , gifts , Dl WB 643 ); — Qal Imperfect 2feminine singular, accusative of person אוֺתָם וַתִּשְׁחֳדִי Ezek 16:33 thou didst bribe them to come ( לָבוֺא ; || נְדָנִים נָתַן ); read probably also Infinitive construct suffix שַׁחֲדָהּ Isa 47:11 to buy it off (for שַׁחְרָהּ ᵑ0 , so Kr Gr Buhl Che Hpt Heb 142 , compare Marti; see Prov 6:35 ); Imperative masculine plural בַעֲדִי שִׁחֲדוּ (Ges § 64a ) Job 6:22 give a bribe for me.
